title: Anth.us style-profile: noEmojis and contrastCap from voice audit
description:
LIM-fc61e8 voice audit: Anth.us site-content README Voice requires no emojis and at most one X-not-Y contrast. publications/anthus/style-profile.yml has neither rules.noEmojis nor rules.contrastCap.

## Change
publications/anthus/style-profile.yml only:
- rules.noEmojis: true
- rules.contrastCap: 1

Sanity-check against published Anth.us articles (Papyrus reference-samples and/or anthus-site-content) so we do not ship a false positive on house copy.

## Out of scope
Limatus core. Chattic.us profile (separate repo). Noun-compound density LIM-74d5fb.

comments.text: Closed: #81 on develop. noEmojis true. contrastCap not encoded — 24 published MDX files use multiple intentional X-not-Y contrasts (house voice).

right_now_summary: The Anth.us style profile needs updates to fit the voice audit rules for emojis and contrast limits.
